about: P145 seed of the group structure (agentic/org/structure.py). units, positions, approval_rules and source_notes are copied from the extraction of DIRECTOR OFFICE GORVERNANCE.pdf and GOVERNMENT OPERATION.pdf (no personal data). role_map: the office role each position's holders usually get (owner never). standing_units / standing_positions: the companies and central departments the PDFs leave out. links: the office company (branch name marks, or 'group' for PWVSB) and the PWVSB department (Prima mirror key) a unit stands for. unit_name / unit_ms / unit_kind: short names, Malay names and kinds used instead of the extraction's.
source_notes: Both PDFs are Microsoft Loop page prints (DIRECTOR OFFICE GORVERNANCE.pdf = 3 pages, GOVERNMENT OPERATION.pdf = 2 pages). All content is in embedded infographic images (no selectable text apart from the page header). Pages: DOG p1 = cover photo + Loop page header (page author listed; not a role in the structure); DOG p2 = 'Director Office Governance - proposed working model' infographic; DOG p3 = two images: 'Group Director Office - Role & Duty Hierarchy Map' and 'Group Director Office - Consolidated Key Task Map' (T01-T24). GOV p1 = cover photo + 'Goodwill Empire Sdn Bhd - Government Operations' infographic (org structure, approvals, deadlines); GOV p2 = second 'Government Operations' infographic (org structure, 7 regions table, approval workflow). IMPORTANT: every title in both PDFs is in ENGLISH; there are no Malay (jawatan) titles. title_ms therefore holds the exact English title as printed; 'ms_suggested' is OUR suggested Malay rendering for matching (not from the PDFs). Both documents are marked PROPOSED ('proposed governance mapping, not approved reporting changes'; 'subject to approved organisation chart and Delegation of Authority'). No person holding any role is named, so no holder_hint values are filled. 'functional_to' = dotted-line coordination (not line management); 'also_reports_to' = second solid reporting line where the PDF names two bosses. The group root unit (PWVSB) comes from the briefing and the SharePoint tenant name in the print URL, not from the chart itself. Sasa Team, Merdeka Network and Perfect Global Logistics are not mentioned in either PDF.

approval_rules.rule: Approvals stay with authorised decision-makers; tracking work does not transfer responsibility; a readiness checklist supports a decision but does not replace approval.
Administrators (HR Admin, DOA, AP, local company admins) do not gain HR approval, payment-release, board or tender-signing authority. ACT assurance remains independent.
Vice Chairman: final reserved HR decisions (headcount, recruitment, remuneration, KPI, material placement); HR cases go via COS; CEO review does not replace it.
Finance: banking, payroll and payments under approved mandates. Boards / authorised management: statutory, tender and expenditure approvals. Each company board keeps its legal duties.

Government bids: assigned operational teams prepare; Finance validates financial material; authorised management approves; DOA monitors only. Private tenders stay with COO / Private Sector Department.
CEO: operational SOP approval and management decisions.

OGM approves (with written reason, within limits): extra man-hours (add-only, with cause), wage advances (1/month, <= last month's wages, raised by OM/ROM), government hostel bills (after FWM checks, company pays), payment requests (department step; then Finance/FD/CEO approve payment), procurement staff time slips (within 30 days, 4-hour cap), item losses & disposals (Goodwill items), client reports (per government client), new site surveys (as Project Director), public holiday list (11 days per company by 10 December).

OGM does NOT approve: purchases (COO then CEO; 3 supplier quotes), payments (Finance, FD or CEO), staff salaries (Chief of Staff, then COO), guard salary formulas (ACT Director or CEO), management fee amounts (FD or CEO), anything on private sites.
Every approval needs a written reason; nobody approves their own work; proof at every step (photo or document); app suggests discipline but never issues it; companies own guards, sites and contracts.

Case escalation: Site Officer -> Patrolling Officer -> Operations Manager -> Regional Operations Manager -> OGM -> COO -> CEO; resolve at the lowest level; ROM is the last level before OGM. Proposed case time limits (up to ROM): P1 15 min, P2 1 hour, P3 4 hours, P4 1 day.
